text:
Ravi S.: quick PM follow-up  recurring midnight DB connection spikes. need owners for runbook triage, escalation thresholds, and a short mitigation plan (what oncall does in first 10m). who can take items?

Elena P.: i'll own the triage one-pager. will add exact copy/paste commands and a 3-step fast mitigation. target PR: 7 business days.

Mark D.: i'll own alerts & escalation mapping. propose thresholds: conn_util > 0.80 for 6m -> L2, >0.94 for 2m -> L1 + exec. will add pager text and weekend fallback. due in 5 business days.

Elena P.: draft triage snippets i'll include:
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=5m | grep -i "connection"
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=60s
(and a short validation check to confirm conn_util drop)

runbooks-bot: Created actions: PM-7001 (triage one-pager) assigned Elena P. due 2024-06-14, PM-7002 (alerts & escalation) assigned Mark D. due 2024-06-12. Link: https://tracker.redwood/PM-7001

Ravi S.: please add due dates & a 1-line test plan in tracker by EOD. also capture recurring root cause (overlapping nightly jobs) as a separate action and assign to app leads.

Mark D.: will add pager templates to runbook and update alert descriptions to include runbook URL.

Elena P.: confirmed. PR will include a 2-step validation for oncall and rollback notes.

Ravi S.: thanks. i'll kick off weekly 15m check-ins until actions are closed. tag PM-7001/7002 in PRs and link the postmortem. :thumbsup:
